summary: xAI announced that its Grok 4.6 coding model is now available inside GitHub Copilot (VS Code, cloud agents, Copilot CLI) and via the SpaceXAI API console at stated per-token pricing.

practices.reason: Enterprises using GitHub Copilot may need to enable the new model in settings, a minor configuration change rather than a breaking migration.
practices.quote: Some businesses and enterprises will need to enable the model from Copilot settings.
